segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: 你好，今天先看一下发布进度。

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: 支付问题昨天已经修好了。

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: 那仪表盘的设计还需要一天。

reference_segments: Hello, let's start by reviewing the release status today.
The payment issue was fixed yesterday.
The dashboard design needs one more day.
notes: Translate 发布进度 as release status, not publishing progress.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: 客户说明天上午十点再确认合同。

reference_segments: The client said they will confirm the contract again at 10 a.m. tomorrow.
I'll prepare the English version first.
Remember to attach the old quote as well.
notes: 报价 should be translated as quote in this sales context.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: 这个候选人做过搜索和推荐系统。

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: 但他对实时流处理经验一般。

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: 我们可以安排下一轮系统设计。

reference_segments: This candidate has worked on search and recommendation systems.
But his experience with real-time stream processing is only moderate.
We can schedule the next round for system design.
notes: Translate 系统设计 as system design in the interview sense.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: 昨晚十一点开始延迟明显升高。

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: 原因是缓存集群有两个节点掉线。

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: 早上两点切流以后就恢复了。

reference_segments: Latency started to rise noticeably at 11 p.m. last night.
The cause was that two nodes in the cache cluster went offline.
It recovered after we shifted traffic at 2 a.m.
notes: 切流 means shifting traffic, not simply switching.
